SELECT , , ,
FROM feedbacks feedback JOIN gc_user u ON feedback.user_id = u.id JOIN gc_user_info user_info ON u.info_id = user_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file user_avatar_file ON user_info.avatar_file_id = user_avatar_file.id WHERE feedback.updated_time >= #{startDate} AND feedback.updated_time <= #{endDate} AND feedback.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY feedback.updated_time
